explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/856 ('f_3(N) ≤ (log N)^{0.889} … for all large N') and the abstract of arXiv:2512.20055, which gives f_k(N) ≪ (log N)^{μ_k^S − 1 + o(1)}; for k = 3 the Naslund–Sawin bound μ_3^S ≤ 3/2^{2/3} gives exponent 3/2^{2/3} − 1 ≈ 0.8899. The Lean statement: for every ε > 0, f 3 N ≤ (log N)^{3/2^{2/3} − 1 + ε} for all large N, with the implied constant absorbed into ε. The docstring correctly notes that the page's 0.889 is a slightly too-small rounding of 0.8898…. Faithful to the paper.
